$comment: Bedrock feasibility verdicts for Vanilla Tweaks packs we do not ship. Populated by the agent research pass described in AGENTS.md. Every entry must cite at least one trusted source — `feasibility.mjs --validate` enforces it. Keys are Vanilla Tweaks pack `name` values.

SomeVanillaTweaksPackName.summary: One sentence a maintainer can read without opening anything else.
SomeVanillaTweaksPackName.mechanism: How it would actually be built on Bedrock, or what specifically blocks it.
SomeVanillaTweaksPackName.caveats: Optional. Partial support, version floor, platform differences.
